answer_1.quote: The most common and important evaluation method of summarization systems is assessing the similarity between system-generated summaries and reference summaries.

answer_2.quote: Automatic metric performance is measured by the correlation between the automatic metric scores and human evaluation scores of the system-generated summaries.

answer_4.quote: It contains human evaluation recall scores of the system-generated summaries based on the reference summaries w.r.t. the information similarity on three summarization datasets, CNN/DailyMail (CNNDM), XSum, and SamSum.
answer_4.guideline: The human evaluation is conducted following the ACU evaluation protocol (Liu et al. 2023), which uses atomic content units, or ACUs, as the simple facts for comparing text sequences.
